card.name: The word to in missed-dose instructions
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after a dosing phrase such as "extra doses" or "adjust the schedule", especially in missed-dose instructions. It also fires on "to" in "proportional to".

modes.label: Make up a missed dose
modes.description: "to" after "do not take extra doses/tablets" or "double the dose", introducing "make up for the missed dose".
modes.example: Do not take extra tablets<< to>> make up for the missed dose.

modes.label: Adjust schedule to keep interval
modes.description: "to" after "adjust the schedule" that introduces keeping the dosing interval.
modes.example: adjust the dosing schedule<< to>> maintain the dosing interval.

modes.label: Proportional to exposure
modes.example: The risk of cardiomyopathy is proportional<< to>> the cumulative exposure

card.writes: It seems to push toward verbs like maintain or make up and away from time units such as hours and minutes.
card.plain: It fires on the word "to" in phrases like "do not take extra doses to make up for a missed dose."
